bug_semantics: mailboxes/detach.cgi is the Read User Mail attachment viewer. On View/Open it prints the attachment bytes with Content-Type copied from $attach->{'type'} (email MIME) or the type= query override. An SVG attachment typed image/svg+xml (or named .svg/.svgz) is therefore served as an SVG document on the Webmin origin; the browser executes embedded <script> or onload handlers (stored XSS, CWE-79, CVSS 6.1 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N). text/html attachments were already run through filter_javascript; SVG was not treated as a script-capable type. Attack: deliver a hostile SVG to a mailbox the victim can read, then have them open it in the mailboxes UI.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable mechanism is the native MIME passthrough in mailboxes/detach.cgi, first written in the GitHub-era root import 27d3d6cb9738150bc944ae17ebe8fc8a6396012e (Jamie Cameron, 2007-04-12, 'Test checkin of some modules'). That file already did print "Content-type: $attach->{'type'}\n\n" and printed $attach->{'data'} unless the type matched text/html. git cat-file -p shows no parent; git diff-tree --root names the file A.
